title: Python secret management
body: Do not store passwords, tokens, or API keys directly in source code. Read them from environment variables or a secret manager and avoid logging sensitive values.

title: JavaScript input validation boundaries
body: Validate request parameters and body data as early as possible. Treat all client input as untrusted and avoid building SQL or shell commands with string concatenation.

title: Performance hotspots
body: Look for nested loops, repeated scans, or repeated I/O inside loops. Cache repeated work when possible and measure before optimizing.

title: Large function maintainability
body: Large routines often combine multiple responsibilities. Smaller units improve readability, testing, and safer refactoring.

title: Logging discipline
body: Prefer structured logging over print statements or console.log in production code. Logs should provide debugging value without leaking secrets.

title: Python mutable default arguments
body: Default list or dict arguments are shared across calls. Use None defaults and initialize mutable objects inside the function body.

title: Parameterized SQL
body: Queries should be parameterized instead of concatenating user-controlled strings. This protects against injection and often improves query handling.
